newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan family thieves follow father's footsteps.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan family thieves follow father's footsteps.

text.p: Moroccan police have arrested three brothers who confessed to following in their father's footsteps and stealing 45 luxury cars from Morocco's main cities.

The father's tally was around 50 luxury limousines, for whose theft he is serving a 10-year prison sentence imposed in 1995. His accomplices, a fourth son and a nephew, were jailed at the same time for six years each.

The three brothers, according to police, went one step further than their father, using the cars to carry out 31 armed robberies with a haul totalling 1.2 million dirhams ($126,000), the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Wednesday. ($ = 9.470 Moroccan Dirhams)
